answer: Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 10 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Because the jade cliff is fixed at deposit and written down in the ledge ledger, the delta audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. A farm of 76 pays that 277 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
